title: Establish spectral accent anchors and modular radius rules for table & chart components
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: The current token set for accents and corner radii behaves inconsistently across table rows, dataviz cards, and small actionable cards. This has led to visual noise when lists and charts are rendered at different breakpoints and causes edge cases where elevation and color contrast fail accessibility checks at 14px body sizes.

Goal: Create a concise set of spectral accent anchors (4 anchor hues with light/dark deltas) and a modular radius system (micro, regular, and container radii) that are:
- accessible at typical data-surface sizes (rows, cells, sparklines)
- responsive across breakpoints with predictable deltas
- compatible with existing shadow/elevation ramps so combined interaction states keep contrast and perceived depth stable

Scope: Design tokens (color ramps for accents, semantic aliasing for data-foreground/background, radius scale of 0/4/8/12), updated examples/specs for: tables (row hover, selected row, cell emphasis), chart cards (header/legend surfaces, tooltips), and small controls embedded inside lists (chip, icon button). Produce migration guidance and a small test harness for QA and perf teams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Token file with 4 spectral accent anchors published and consumed by component library; 2) Radius scale defined and tokenized with responsive deltas (mobile/tablet/desktop); 3) Updated table and chart component specs (Figma) with before/after examples; 4) Color contrast checks pass WCAG AA for body sizes >= 14px and AA for large text where applicable; 5) Two engineering PRs (tokens and component styles) merged with automated visual diffs under threshold; 6) Migration guide and roll-out plan documented in Confluence.
migration_plan: Stage 1: Land tokens in a non-breaking 'alias' layer so components can opt in. Stage 2: Convert a small set of internal pages (metrics dashboard, user lists) to opt-in tokens and validate automated visual diffs. Stage 3: Flip feature flag for broader rollout with rollback path to legacy tokens. Communication: announce change in #design-system and tag product owners for dashboards. Include a script to map old token names to new aliases for quick switchback.
engineering_notes: ENG owners: @miguel-h to coordinate token module (styles/tokens/spectral) and @sara-li to add responsive radius mixin. Performance: ensure CSS vars are used and tree-shaken for dedicated builds. Kernel: no runtime changes expected. See ENG-55123 for CI visual diff thresholds. Add unit tests for contrast calculations and snapshot tests for table states.
qa_checks: Visual diff against baseline for table rows, chart cards, and chip components
Contrast audit (axe-core) on representative pages at 320px/768px/1440px
Interactive state regression: hover, focus, selected, disabled across tokens
Regression test for elevation layering: ensure shadow+accent combos match spec images
Accessibility keyboard navigation and focus ring visibility
comments: 2025-11-05 - Kickoff: aligned with PM on scope; agreed to limit anchors to 4 hues to minimize cognitive load for product teams.

2025-12-12 - Design review: prototype shows improved perceived depth on chart cards but edge contrast on small table badges still failing; Miguel to try slight darkening in token delta for small badges.
2026-01-20 - Engineering spike complete: CSS variable approach is performant; added responsive radius mixin for media-query deltas. PR draft created: github.com/redwood/tokens/pull/174
2026-02-09 - Accessibility review meeting: a11y team requested explicit semantic token aliases for 'data-emphasis' and 'data-muted' to avoid accidental usage of raw accent colors in copy text.
2026-02-28 - Design QA: updated Figma components with final radius values (4/8/12) and published component variants for table-row dense/normal modes.
2026-03-03 - PM signoff on rollout sequence. Documented migration script and rollback steps in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Spectral+Anchors+Migration
2026-03-10 - Engineering: merged token module PR and opened components PR for table/chart styles (ENG-PR-392). Awaiting visual diff check to pass on CI.
